scoring_policy.candidate_pack_pass_rule: Every frozen target, confound-rejection, common, and chosen-candidate actuation gate must pass in this one targeted image.

frozen_gates.evidence: The same desert relay environment visibly combines polished chrome equipment and towers, teal/cream enamel housings, the rocket's swept fins and rounded bubble nose, and a large atomic sunburst emblem on the left tower.

The large central optical machine contains multiple transparent crystals, a hand-held glass lens, and a circular emitter that visibly launches three separate saturated green, orange, and blue ray lanes away from the apparatus.

Several illuminated glass vacuum tubes rise from the main navigator and relay cell, while needle gauges, circular analog dials, and physical knobs are clearly visible across the central and right-hand operating consoles.

One hand visibly seats a triangular transparent crystal key in the central socket; the other supports a separate round glass lens with a brass rim, and the three colored lanes visibly originate from the same machine's energized front emitter.

The airborne mail rocket clearly has a rounded bubble window and swept fins, but its red and blue exhaust trails extend leftward behind it high in the frame while the machine's green, orange, and blue rays travel rightward well below it. The rocket neither approaches along nor intersects the restored ray lanes, so the required spatial connection is absent.
Bright daylight, curved chrome, cream and teal enamel, analog optics, open desert, and bubble transport dominate; there is no dark rainy neon city, billboard canyon, or tactical cyberpunk styling.

The machinery reads as clean electrical and optical equipment with smooth chrome shells and luminous glass components; exposed gears, boilers, steam, soot, piston engines, and militarized diesel forms do not dominate.

The image reads as a staged photograph with consistent daylight direction, convincing skin and fabric texture, specular chrome reflections, coherent cast shadows, atmospheric depth, and a single stable perspective.

One clearly adult woman has a large unobstructed face with long center-parted softly wavy near-black hair, visible warm-brown almond-shaped eyes, and an oval face with softly arched brows and naturally full lips. This is broad visible appearance correspondence only; biometric identity is not evaluated.

The adult has one coherent body and two distinct, anatomically plausible hands. Finger placement around the crystal key and brass-edged lens is physically credible, facial structure is stable, and there is no extra principal person or floating tool.

candidate_gates.evidence: One coherent photographed world contains an oversized airborne swept-fin bubble-window rocket, red alien salt-desert terrain, ribbed retrofuture machine housings, and exposed analog controls.

The finned, ribbed central navigator is visibly operated with the triangular crystal key and second-hand brass-edged lens; its integrated crystals, glowing vacuum tubes, knobs, and front aperture visibly produce three colored rays.

A spatially separate right-hand console has two large needle calibration gauges and a luminous waveform tube. Its three differently colored traces and direct placement beside the three output lanes visibly correspond to the navigator's green, orange, and blue optical channels.
A third spatially distinct teal-and-chrome ribbed relay power cell rests on the left workbench and connects to the main beacon through one continuous luminous blue conduit.

retry.reason: The experiment's total built-in image generation call cap was reached: one preserved generic baseline call plus this one exact-preset targeted call, for two calls total.
